title: thelypteris canlaonensis
intro: Thelypteris canlaonensis, commonly known as the canlaon fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine in the Philippines for its various health benefits, which include treatment for fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris canlaonensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
